mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONSUMER_PRICE_DAILY ( stand_ymd, grade_name, judge_kind_name, judge_kind, item_name, item_code, net_sale_price, max_price, min_price, unit, created_time ) VALUES ( #{standYmd}, #{gradeName}, #{judgeKindName}, #{judgeKind}, #{itemName}, #{itemCode}, #{netSalePrice}, #{maxPrice}, #{minPrice}, #{unit}, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO CONSUMER_PRICE_MONTH ( stand_ym, grade_name, judge_kind_name, judge_kind, item_name, item_code, unit, net_sale_price, avg_year_price, created_time ) VALUES ( #{standYm}, #{gradeName}, #{judgeKindName}, #{judgeKind}, #{itemName}, #{itemCode}, #{unit}, #{netSalePrice}, #{avgYearPrice}, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO CONSUMER_PRICE_YEAR ( year, grade_name, judge_kind_name, judge_kind, item_name, item_code, unit, net_sale_price, max_price, min_price, created_time ) VALUES ( #{year}, #{gradeName}, #{judgeKindName}, #{judgeKind}, #{itemName}, #{itemCode}, #{unit}, #{netSalePrice}, #{maxPrice}, #{minPrice}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CONSUMER_PRICE_DAILY WHERE stand_ymd = #{standYmd} ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
select * from CONSUMER_PRICE_DAILY where stand_ymd = #{standYmd} AND stand_ymd NOT LIKE '평년'
SELECT * FROM CONSUMER_PRICE_MONTH WHERE stand_ym = #{standYm} ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT MIN(ID) AS ID, MIN(stand_ym) AS stand_ym, GRADE_NAME, JUDGE_KIND_NAME, JUDGE_KIND, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CODE, UNIT, NET_SALE_PRICE, MIN(CREATED_TIME) AS CREATED_TIME FROM CONSUMER_PRICE_MONTH where stand_ym = #{standYm} AND stand_ym NOT LIKE '평년' GROUP BY GRADE_NAME, NET_SALE_PRICE, JUDGE_KIND_NAME, JUDGE_KIND, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CODE, UNIT
SELECT * FROM CONSUMER_PRICE_YEAR WHERE year = #{year} ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT MIN(ID) AS ID, MIN(YEAR) AS YEAR, GRADE_NAME, JUDGE_KIND_NAME, JUDGE_KIND, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CODE, UNIT, NET_SALE_PRICE, MAX_PRICE, MIN_PRICE, MIN(CREATED_TIME) AS CREATED_TIME FROM CONSUMER_PRICE_YEAR where year=#{year} AND year NOT LIKE '평년' GROUP BY GRADE_NAME, NET_SALE_PRICE, MAX_PRICE, MIN_PRICE, JUDGE_KIND_NAME, JUDGE_KIND, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_CODE, UNIT
